method.description: Actually visually inspected four chronological sheets using view_image, every fourth frame plus last, against individually viewed exact-hash approved source. FFmpeg decoding limited to two CPU threads; no GPU submission or painting processor. Live Comfy history verified successful generation.

observations: Toucan performs a bounded wing lift and lowering with beak opening, subtle body bobbing and blinking; meaningful character motion is visible across samples.
One visible wing extends coherently from the body and folds back; both blue feet retain their grip on the branch. Head, eye, beak and tail remain coherent without observed extra or malformed anatomy.
Black body, white throat, yellow eye patch and orange two-part beak preserve the approved source appearance.

Branch and all three green leaves persist, with no faces on props. Bird, extended wing, beak, tail and branch remain fully inside the image throughout sampled frames; no cropping or unintended morphing observed.
limitations: Sampled visual inspection is not realtime playback or inspection of every frame. Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of inter-sample artifacts or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
